'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Profit'''. Username '''Blary'''. L13–16 Luke SITF → Master Luke×4. L38–39 SATM+BP → Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency. L40 Armed+Dangerous+KDH → Krayt Dragon Howl & Armed And Dangerous. L55 IMBATS → I Must Be Allowed To Speak (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' Blary
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
